title: Drift-admissibility via Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2611.08505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce structure-aware optimal transport diagnostics for assessing whether empirical time-series dynamics are compatible with a prescribed predictable-drift class. Our approach translates a pathwise property of stochastic processes into a finite-dimensional projection problem over empirical transition laws, encoding admissibility as row-wise moment constraints on local couplings and quantifying deviations via a Kullback--Leibler projection gap $G_{\lambda,k}$. This yields both a principled diagnostic and a scalable Bregman--Dykstra algorithm that retains the efficiency of Sinkhorn-type methods while incorporating structural constraints. Calibrated against a Brownian reference null, $G_{\lambda,k}$ separates process classes that are indistinguishable by second-order statistics alone---including fractional Brownian motion and BSS processes sharing identical Hurst indices---without asymptotic resampling or continuous-time recovery. translated_title: 基于最优传输的漂移可容许性检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种结构感知的最优传输诊断方法，用于评估经验时间序列动态是否与指定的可预测漂移类相容。该方法将随机过程的路径性质转化为经验转移律上的有限维投影问题，把可容许性编码为局部耦合上的行方向矩约束，并通过 Kullback–Leibler 投影间隙 $G_{\lambda,k}$ 来量化偏差。这不仅提供了一个有理论依据的诊断工具，还带来了一种可扩展的 Bregman–Dykstra 算法，该算法在引入结构性约束的同时保留了 Sinkhorn 类方法的计算效率。以布朗运动参考零假设进行校准后，$G_{\lambda,k}$ 能够区分仅凭二阶统计量无法分辨的过程类别——包括具有相同 Hurst 指数的分数布朗运动与 BSS 过程——且无需渐近重采样或连续时间恢复。
tldr: 该论文提出基于最优传输的结构感知诊断方法，利用 KL 投影间隙与可扩展的 Bregman–Dykstra 算法检验时间序列是否符合指定可预测漂移类，并能区分二阶统计量无法分辨的过程（如同 Hurst 指数的分数布朗运动与 BSS 过程）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces structure-aware optimal transport diagnostics using a KL projection gap and a scalable Bregman–Dykstra algorithm to test whether time-series dynamics are compatible with a prescribed predictable-drift class, distinguishing processes (e.g., fractional Brownian motion and BSS processes with identical Hurst indices) that are indistinguishable by second-order statistics alone.
